A provider returning web.DataProvider adds WithData to the generated adapter.

-- web/templates.go --
package web

import "embed"

//fabrik:templates
//go:embed all:templates
var Templates embed.FS
-- web/templates/_default/_layout.html --
<html>{{ block "content" .Page }}{{ end }}</html>
-- web/templates/_default/home.html --
{{ define "content" }}{{ .Title }}{{ end }}
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

type HomePage struct {
	Title string
}

func (HomePage) Template() string { return "home" }

type WebData struct {
	Page any
	Path string
}

//fabrik:provider
func NewWebData() web.DataProvider {
	return func(r *http.Request, page any) (any, error) {
		return WebData{Page: page, Path: r.URL.Path}, nil
	}
}

type Handlers struct{}

//fabrik:web GET /home
func (h *Handlers) Home(req *web.Request) (web.Response, error) {
	return web.View(HomePage{Title: "hi"}), nil
}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/templates"
	web2 "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"

	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		webTemplates, err := templates.Load(web.Templates, "templates")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		webWebDataProvider := web.NewWebData()
		adapter := web2.NewAdapter(web2.WithRenderer(webTemplates), web2.WithData(webWebDataProvider))

		r := router.New()
		webHandlers := &web.Handlers{}

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/home", adapter.Wrap(webHandlers.Home))
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
